## Spoken count-in, new drum kit and more level
- **Spoken count-in.** Choose **Voice** from the Count In sound menu for spoken English numbers. It follows the time signature and restarts at one for each count-in bar. At fast tempos the words shorten without raising their pitch. Keep Internal Audio on to hear it. - **New internal drum kit.** Your own Default recordings for kick, snare, ghost snare, cross-stick, hi-hats, three toms, ride and crash, plus a bundled Ride Bell. Flams use the same generated grace stroke, instrument rows and MIDI mappings are unchanged, and the open hi-hat keeps its recorded decay until a closed or pedal hi-hat chokes it. - **Louder.** The kit is 10 dB louder, and the internal drum faders now have three times the gain: a fader at about **50** is a comfortable level, with more available above it. Your saved fader positions are kept, so after updating bring the instrument faders to around 50 and balance from there. A peak limiter keeps loud hits together within output range. - Count-in sounds use short buffers so fast counts stay on time. Automated checks now run silently and never send external MIDI.
BeatBake 1.0 (173). Requires Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later.
